name: Comeuppance
description: The Comeuppance, otherwise known as Zorii Bliss's Y-Wing, was a modified BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter owned by Zorii Bliss, leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Bliss purchased the Y-wing for around 40,000 credits after the First Order began raiding the planet Kijimi by 33 ABY. In 35 ABY, Bliss escaped Kijimi in the Comeuppance before the Sith Eternal destroyed the planet on the orders of Darth Sidious, taking the droidsmith Babu Frik with her. She later joined up with the Resistance in the Comeuppance as a member of the Citizens' Fleet at the Battle of Exegol.
